name: Paid Pilot Milestone Contract Verification
phase: Metrics, Telemetry, and Innovation Accounting Tactics
hypothesis: We believe enterprises will pay for our complete workflow solution. We will verify this by executing 3 paid commercial pilot agreements with explicit performance milestones, and consider it validated if at least 2 enterprise accounts meet their operational criteria and convert to multi-year contracts upon completion.
schematic: Pilot at step 2 of the 3-step strip

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Draft a pilot agreement with target milestones, integration dates and auto-converting production pricing.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Deploy inside the enterprise and support the team until it hits the agreed milestones.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Track the contractual metrics and how many pilots convert to multi-year production licences.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Draft a commercial pilot agreement specifying target operational milestones, integration timelines, and auto-converting production pricing terms.

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Deploy the system inside the enterprise environment, providing operational support to ensure the team hits the agreed performance milestones.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Track progress against the contractually agreed metrics and record conversion rates to multi-year production licenses.

warning.label: Perpetual Pilot Trap
warning.text: Buyers use cheap pilots to run exploratory tests or meet an innovation quota, never to roll out.

warningFull: Enterprise buyers sometimes use low-cost innovation pilots to run exploratory tests or satisfy internal innovation quotas without intending to secure broad organizational rollout.
